definitions.explanation: Plates, bowls, cups, and other items used for serving and eating food.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{食器|しょっき}⟦セット→セット：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new dinnerware set.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}⟦{棚|だな}→食器棚：07097_shokkidana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片|かた}づけた→片づける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put away the plates in the cupboard.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}⟦{洗|あら}い{機|き}→食器洗い機：04673_shokkiaraiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{片|かた}づけ→片づけ：02625_katazuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Having a dishwasher makes the daily cleanup much easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引っ越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食器|しょっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}らないよう→割る：02334_waru⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{新聞紙|しんぶんし}→新聞紙：20415_shinbunshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: When moving, I wrapped each piece of tableware in newspaper and put it in a box so nothing would break.

notes:
{食器|しょっき} is a collective term for plates, bowls, cups, and other items used for serving and eating food. It covers both Japanese-style and Western-style tableware.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食器|しょっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash dishes
- {食器|しょっき}⟦{棚|だな}→食器棚：07097_shokkidana⟧: cupboard, dish cabinet
- {食器|しょっき}⟦{洗|あら}い{機|き}→食器洗い機：04673_shokkiaraiki⟧: dishwasher
- {食器|しょっき}⟦セット→セット：noentry⟧: dinnerware set
- {食器|しょっき}⟦{乾燥機|かんそうき}→乾燥機：04672_kansouki⟧: dish dryer

INCLUDES:
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plates
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧: rice bowls
- ⟦{椀|わん}→椀：00419_wan⟧: soup bowls
- ⟦コップ→コップ：noentry⟧/⟦グラス→グラス：noentry⟧: cups/glasses

Note: ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧ (chopsticks) and spoons are technically {食器|しょっき} but are sometimes categorized separately as ⟦カトラリー→カトラリー：18140_katorarii⟧ (cutlery). {食器|しょっき} most commonly refers to the vessels (plates, bowls, cups).
